{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''North Texas Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001592000/000159200015000005/enlc201410-k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from near Fort Worth, Tarrant County, Texas to near Paris, Lamar County, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001592000/000159200015000005/enlc201410-k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''EnLink Midstream LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001592000/000159200015000005/enlc201410-k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''250 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17281781/crosstex-energy-completes-n-texas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chron.com/news/article/prn-crosstex-energy-completes-115-million-1884401.php|title=chron.com|website=chron.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''140 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001592000/000159200015000005/enlc201410-k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17281781/crosstex-energy-completes-n-texas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chron.com/news/article/prn-crosstex-energy-completes-115-million-1884401.php|title=chron.com|website=chron.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17281781/crosstex-energy-completes-n-texas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chron.com/news/article/prn-crosstex-energy-completes-115-million-1884401.php|title=chron.com|website=chron.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001592000/000159200015000005/enlc201410-k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001592000/000159200015000005/enlc201410-k.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2005
*'''Cost: '''US$115,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/article/17281781/crosstex-energy-completes-n-texas-pipeline|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chron.com/news/article/prn-crosstex-energy-completes-115-million-1884401.php|title=chron.com|website=chron.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
